title: Payment failures due to DB connection pool exhaustion from long-running refund job
symptoms: POST /payments failing with SQLTransientConnectionException 'Connection is not available'; Hikari active=max, many threads waiting; error rate above 40%; order-service circuit breaker opened.
rootCause: Refund batch job held a single DB connection/transaction for the entire batch and processed batches in parallel, starving the Hikari pool used by API requests.
resolution: Paused refund job, restarted pods to release connections. Permanent fix: chunked commits every 200 records and a separate small connection pool for batch jobs.

title: Order service timeouts caused by slow payment gateway
symptoms: order-service SocketTimeoutException calling payment-service; payment-service healthy but external gateway latency 8s.
rootCause: Third-party payment gateway degradation in one region.
resolution: Failed over to secondary gateway; reduced client timeout and added fallback queue.

title: Inventory service OOM after cache size change
symptoms: Pods restarting with OutOfMemoryError; heap at 98%; reservation API 503s.
rootCause: Config change raised local cache max entries from 10k to 1M.
resolution: Rolled back config; moved cache to Redis.

title: Payment duplicate charges due to retry without idempotency key
symptoms: Customers charged twice; duplicate rows in payments table for same orderId.
rootCause: order-service retry on timeout did not send idempotency key after a client library upgrade.
resolution: Restored idempotency header; refunded duplicates; added unique constraint on orderId.

title: Postgres disk full on reporting replica
symptoms: Replica lag increasing; 'No space left on device' in Postgres logs.
rootCause: WAL files retained by inactive replication slot.
resolution: Dropped stale replication slot; added disk usage alert at 80%.

title: Kafka consumer lag on notification service
symptoms: Emails delayed by 40 minutes; consumer lag 2M messages.
rootCause: Consumer rebalancing loop due to max.poll.interval.ms exceeded by slow SMTP calls.
resolution: Moved SMTP sending to async worker pool; increased poll interval.

title: Order service connection pool leak after ORM upgrade
symptoms: Gradual increase in Hikari active connections over 6 hours, then timeouts acquiring connections.
rootCause: Hibernate upgrade changed session handling; streaming query results were not closed.
resolution: Closed streams with try-with-resources; enabled Hikari leakDetectionThreshold.

title: TLS certificate expiry broke payment-service to bank API
symptoms: All outbound bank API calls failing with SSLHandshakeException; payments 100% failing.
rootCause: Client certificate for bank mTLS expired; renewal reminder missed.
resolution: Rotated certificate; added cert expiry monitoring 30 days ahead.

title: High CPU on inventory service from regex in search
symptoms: CPU 95% on all pods; search endpoint p99 12s.
rootCause: Catastrophic backtracking regex on user-supplied SKU pattern.
resolution: Replaced regex with prefix match; added input length limit.

title: Payment service slow after missing index in migration
symptoms: Payment status lookups p99 6s; Postgres CPU high; sequential scans on payments table.
rootCause: Migration dropped and recreated table without index on order_id.
resolution: Added index concurrently; added migration review checklist.

title: Circuit breaker stuck open in order service
symptoms: Orders failing with CallNotPermittedException although payment-service recovered.
rootCause: Health probe excluded from half-open calls; misconfigured permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState=0.
resolution: Fixed resilience4j config; added alert on breaker state duration.

title: Redis eviction caused inventory reservation loss
symptoms: Reservations disappearing; oversold stock on flash sale.
rootCause: Redis maxmemory reached with allkeys-lru policy evicting reservation keys.
resolution: Switched to volatile-lru, increased memory, persisted reservations in Postgres.

title: Payment service thread pool exhaustion from slow fraud check
symptoms: Tomcat threads busy=200; requests queued; DB pool mostly idle.
rootCause: Synchronous fraud-check call with no timeout during fraud vendor slowdown.
resolution: Added 2s timeout and fallback rules; bulkhead for fraud client.

title: Deployment rollback after bad feature flag
symptoms: Checkout page errors for 10% of users after flag rollout.
rootCause: New pricing flag returned null discount for legacy carts.
resolution: Disabled flag; added null handling and canary rollout.

title: DNS resolution failures in cluster
symptoms: Intermittent UnknownHostException across multiple services.
rootCause: CoreDNS pods CPU throttled after node autoscaling.
resolution: Increased CoreDNS replicas and CPU limits; enabled NodeLocal DNSCache.

title: Settlement job locked payments table
symptoms: Payment inserts blocked; lock wait timeouts; pg_locks shows exclusive lock held by settlement job.
rootCause: Nightly settlement job ran LOCK TABLE during peak due to timezone misconfiguration.
resolution: Fixed schedule timezone; replaced table lock with row-level updates.

title: Log volume spike filled disk on order service nodes
symptoms: Disk 100% on nodes; pods evicted.
rootCause: DEBUG logging accidentally enabled in production config.
resolution: Reverted log level; added log rotation limits.

title: Payment webhook backlog after Kafka partition reassignment
symptoms: Payment status updates delayed 15 minutes.
rootCause: Partition reassignment left consumer group with fewer active consumers.
resolution: Scaled consumers; documented reassignment runbook.

title: Inventory service 401s after secret rotation
symptoms: Calls to warehouse API failing with 401 Unauthorized.
rootCause: Rotated API secret not reloaded; pods cached old secret.
resolution: Rolling restart; added secret reload on change.

title: Order service memory leak from unbounded in-memory retry queue
symptoms: Heap growing steadily during payment-service outage; GC pauses 4s.
rootCause: Pending-payment retry queue held in memory without a size limit.
resolution: Moved retries to persistent queue with max size and backoff.
